clauses.implication: Primary self-announcement overlaps, but hierarchy between generic terms, current series list and inline terms is unresolved; independent venue determinations need not coincide.

clauses.implication: No proof that Kalshi NO and PM YES still pay one dollar in this exceptional state. Kalshi incorporated rulebook exception text was not fully reconciled; do not infer its treatment from silence.

clauses.kalshi: rules_primary: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez running for US President in 2028, including party nomination.
clauses.poly: description paragraph 1: same candidate, office, election and nomination.
clauses.implication: YES is the announcement on both venues; Kalshi NO plus PM-US YES is the compared complement.

clauses.kalshi: rules_secondary: public formal campaign announcement by the person or official campaign; filing alone and exploratory statements excluded. RUN.pdf p1 Payout Criterion adds after Issuance.
clauses.poly: description paragraph 2: unambiguous declaration by candidate or authorized representatives; conditional and exploratory statements excluded; filing not required.
clauses.implication: Authorized representatives versus official campaign is not exactly the same scope; Kalshi issuance was July 7 while PM listed July 2 and describes announcements in 2026. Treatment of an earlier announcement is not proven identical.

clauses.kalshi: rules_primary: before Jan 1, 2027. RUN.pdf p1 Payout Criterion does not specify an intraday cutoff or timezone for this date; Expiration time is 10:00 AM ET. Current metadata close_time is 2027-01-01T15:00:00Z, but expected_expiration_time and expiration_time are 2028-01-01T15:00:00Z.
clauses.poly: description paragraph 1: by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET; gameStartTime is 2027-01-01T04:59:00Z; endDate is 2027-01-14T23:00:00Z.
clauses.implication: PM deadline is expressly Eastern Time, with last-minute inclusivity unresolved. Kalshi date-only payout cutoff cannot be replaced by its 10 AM expiration clock. Metadata conflicts with generic latest-expiration terms. Administrative dates do not prove cutoff equivalence.

clauses.kalshi: RUN.pdf p1 Source Agency includes the person plus named news agencies. Current series settlement_sources lists 14 news agencies, omitting the person and several agencies in RUN. rules_secondary requires an announcement reported by a Source Agency.
clauses.poly: description paragraph 1: public announcements and communications from Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez. Paragraph 2 permits authorized representatives.
clauses.implication: Primary self-announcement overlaps, but hierarchy between generic terms, current series list and inline terms is unresolved; independent venue determinations need not coincide.

clauses.kalshi: RUN.pdf p1 Underlying excludes post-expiration revisions; p2 Contingencies delegates outcome review and indeterminate-value payouts to Rulebook 6.3(d)/(b).
clauses.poly: Exchange Rulebook September 14, 2026 rules 10.3(b), 10.4: expiry can be changed for delayed data/cancellation; discretionary outcome review and obvious-error reversal.
clauses.implication: No common finality deadline or identical missing-data payout proved.

clauses.kalshi: RUN.pdf contains no matching natural-person price-settlement clause; its general contingency cross-reference remains applicable.
clauses.poly: Exchange Rulebook 10.5(a)-(f), printed pp80-81: disabling death/incapacity may settle at a pre-event traded price, with alternative timing or outcome review.
clauses.implication: No proof that Kalshi NO and PM YES still pay one dollar in this exceptional state. Kalshi incorporated rulebook exception text was not fully reconciled; do not infer its treatment from silence.
